title: Ordinary open tensor cochain data
statement: Let $(C,J,R)$ and $(C',J',R')$ be ringed sites, with independent object and morphism universes $c,v$ and coefficients in universe $\max(c,v,r)$, and assume both categories are essentially small in that coefficient universe. Use the module categories, ordinary sheaf tensor, pure sections, flat terms, K-flat predicate and signed direct-sum total tensor of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Fix exact additive functors $F:\operatorname{Mod}(R')\to\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ and $G:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R')$, an adjunction $F\dashv G$, a functor $H:C\to C'$, and section maps $N(V)\to(GN)(H(V))$. Define $\mathrm{OpenTensorCochainData}$ to consist of: a right adjoint of $G$; a natural ordinary restriction tensor isomorphism $G(M\otimes N)\cong GM\otimes GN$ taking a pure section to the tensor of its specified section images; preservation by $G$ of K-flat complexes with flat terms and their flat terms; a natural ordinary projection isomorphism $FM\otimes N\cong F(M\otimes GN)$ whose inverse has adjunct $\eta_M\otimes1$ followed by the inverse restriction comparison; and a natural cochain isomorphism $\operatorname{Tot}(FC\otimes P)\cong F\operatorname{Tot}(C\otimes GP)$. Its component on the $(a,b)$ summand is exactly the ordinary projection followed by $F$ of the target summand insertion, without any additional sign. No derived tensor comparison or existence choice is part of this definition.
